Layer 1 Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala (R) with mother, Prof Kamene Okonjo
PRESIDENT Bola Tinubu has extended his heartfelt condolences to the Okonjo royal family of Ogwashi-Uku, Delta State, on the passing of Prof. Kamene Okonjo, who died at the age of 96.
Prof. Okonjo was a distinguished scholar, a champion of women’s empowerment, and a revered matriarch.
The President particularly commiserated with her daughter, Dr Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, Director-General of the World Trade Organisation, other family members, and the people of Ogwashi-Uku over the loss of their beloved mother, matriarch, and community leader.
President Tinubu described Prof. Okonjo’s passing as the loss of an accomplished academic whose life was defined by intellectual distinction, service to humanity, and an enduring commitment to advancing women and society.
He acknowledged her contributions to scholarship and her inspiring example as a woman who combined professional excellence with dedication to family, community, and the preservation of traditional institutions.
The President prayed that Almighty God will grant the departed eternal rest and comfort the family and all who mourn her passing.
